theorem lg_target (a b : ℕ) (h : a * b = 12) (ha : a > b) (hb : b > 2) : a = 4 := by
  have h1 : a = 4 := by
    rcases h with ⟨c, d⟩
    cases c with c' d'
    cases d with d' e'
    have h2 : c' * d' = 12 := h
    have h3 : c' > d' := ha
    have h4 : d' > 2 := hb
    have h5 : d' = 3 := by
      rcases h4 with h6
      rcases h6 with h7
      have h8 : d' ≥ 3 := le_of_lt h7
      have h9 : d' ≤ 3 := by
        intro h10
        rw [h10] at h2
        rw [mul_eq_of_left_eq_one (by simp) (by simp)] at h2
        exact lt_irrefl 12 h2
      exact eq_of_le_and_ge h8 h9
    have h10 : c' * 3 = 12 := by rw [h2] at h10
    have h11 : c' = 4 := by
      rw [h10]
      rw [mul_eq_of_left_eq_one (by simp) (by simp)]
    exact h11
